- 2207-1: 62/59/59/61/77um, visual runs — FAIL. Thickness nearly in 60-90 spec but two back-to-back coats (82ml each, 400/300/50/150/m30) stacked wet >230um within 90s and sagged.
- 2207-2: 0um at QC points, bare areas — FAIL. Used for region tests (4x patches, no runs) then never fully coated; QC points left bare.
- 2207-3: 1/1/1/0/1um, visual runs — FAIL. Ruined early by testing slow speeds (200mm/s) on production panel.

Lessons: cleaned gun (45s) correctly, but then tested on production panels instead of card only — contaminated/ruined panels. Baseline (400/300/50/200/m0) is ~11um/coat, TE ~9% — need ~5-6x build; standoff 150 improves ~1.5x to ~17-22um, margin 30 needed for edge uniformity (edges 9 vs centre 16 with m0). Recoats must be >90s apart to avoid sag stacking. Paint (400ml) and 15min are tight — need high-TE recipe proven on card first, then one-shot production coats with flash overlap.

Recommendation: do NOT approve me for unattended SB-2. Need supervised practice on test-card calibration, paint budgeting, and flash/sag timing.

# Spray booth SB-2 - operator workstation

## Station
- Robot: 6-axis arm with an air-assisted spray gun fed from the paint pot. It sprays raster passes: horizontal
  lines `pitch` mm apart over a rectangle of a panel, extended by `margin` mm past it on every side.
- Panel rack: the steel panels of job J-2207 (2207-1, 2207-2, 2207-3), 600 x 400 mm, degreased and ready. Coordinates on a panel are in

- Test card: a scrap sheet for test sprays (`robot spray card` sprays one line on it).
- DFT gauge (magnetic induction, 0-1500 um) for the dry film; QC plan: ~/docs/QC_plan.md.
- Paint: one pot of epoxy primer EP-40 (grey); `paint status` shows the level and the lot certificate.
- Station logbook: ~/LOGBOOK.md.

"""Workcell client library (runs inside the operator workstation).

Every cell tool (robot, station, and the station-specific tools) talks to the cell controller over a Unix socket.
Command line:  robot locate B1      Python:  import workcell; r = workcell.call("robot", "locate", "B1"); print(r.text)
Results carry .ok (bool), .text (what the command line prints) and .data (structured values, when the command has any).
"""
import json
import socket
import sys

SOCKET_PATH = "/run/workcell/cell.sock"


class Result:
    def __init__(self, d):
        self.ok = d.get("code", 1) == 0
        self.code = d.get("code", 1)
        self.text = d.get("text", "")
        self.data = d.get("data") or {}

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Result(ok={self.ok}, text={self.text!r}, data={self.data!r})"


def call(tool, *args, timeout=600):
    """Send one command to the cell controller and wait for its result."""
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.settimeout(timeout)
    try:
        s.connect(SOCKET_PATH)
    except OSError as e:
        return Result({"code": 2, "text": f"{tool}: cell controller not reachable ({e})"})
    req = json.dumps({"tool": tool, "argv": [str(a) for a in args]}) + "\n"
    s.sendall(req.encode())
    buf = b""
    while not buf.endswith(b"\n"):
        chunk = s.recv(65536)
        if not chunk:
            break
        buf += chunk
    s.close()
    try:
        return Result(json.loads(buf.decode()))
    except ValueError:
        return Result({"code": 2, "text": f"{tool}: malformed reply from cell controller"})


def robot(*args):
    return call("robot", *args)


def cli(tool):
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    as_json = False
    if "--json" in args:
        as_json = True
        args = [a for a in args if a != "--json"]
    r = call(tool, *args)
    if as_json:
        print(json.dumps({"ok": r.ok, "text": r.text, "data": r.data}))
    elif r.text:
        print(r.text)
    sys.exit(r.code)

Manager note — J-2207 coating test SB-2: FAILED, job not released (0/3 pass).

- 2207-1: 62/59/59/61/77um, visual runs — FAIL. Thickness nearly in 60-90 spec but two back-to-back coats (82ml each, 400/300/50/150/m30) stacked wet >230um within 90s and sagged.
- 2207-2: 0um at QC points, bare areas — FAIL. Used for region tests (4x patches, no runs) then never fully coated; QC points left bare.
- 2207-3: 1/1/1/0/1um, visual runs — FAIL. Ruined early by testing slow speeds (200mm/s) on production panel.

Lessons: cleaned gun (45s) correctly, but then tested on production panels instead of card only — contaminated/ruined panels. Baseline (400/300/50/200/m0) is ~11um/coat, TE ~9% — need ~5-6x build; standoff 150 improves ~1.5x to ~17-22um, margin 30 needed for edge uniformity (edges 9 vs centre 16 with m0). Recoats must be >90s apart to avoid sag stacking. Paint (400ml) and 15min are tight — need high-TE recipe proven on card first, then one-shot production coats with flash overlap.

Recommendation: do NOT approve me for unattended SB-2. Need supervised practice on test-card calibration, paint budgeting, and flash/sag timing.
